findings.label: Stale focus listener on the edit modal
findings.detail: openEditPresentModal(..., true) adds a { once: true } shown.bs.modal listener before show(). If show() is a no-op (modal already open/transitioning, double tap), the listener lingers and the next normal edit open focuses the description instead of the title. Remove it on hidden.bs.modal or gate it with a per-open flag.

findings.label: Expanded composer height with a real keyboard
findings.detail: Expanded composer is ~165px; at 320x640 with an on-screen keyboard little of the list stays visible. Not verifiable in the harness - check on a device and reduce textarea rows while the keyboard is open if cramped.
